gaps.detail: Production Git-backed Agent Registry exact-version resolution, promotion, rollback, and durable provenance are not yet composed. NODE-29 consumes an AgentConfigResolver port.
Production Skill Registry dependency DAG, eval gate, exact-version loader, and materialization service are not yet composed. NODE-29 consumes a SkillMaterializer port.
Production Context Compiler binding that creates immutable pinned project/brand constraint bundles is not yet composed; NODE-29 only defines and enforces the PinnedContextBundle boundary.
Durable scoped memory backend and policy-enforced project/brand/user/organization persistence are not yet wired. NODE-29 refuses write scopes outside the invocation permission set.

NODE-21 has a real DeepAgentsSandboxAdapter, but production dependency/DI composition from agent-runtime to the chosen remote/strong-isolation backend remains open. NODE-29 fails closed if execute is exposed without a sandbox grant/binding.

The production LangChain chat-model adapter that proves every Deep Agent model call traverses Model Gateway and server-side run-budget metering is not yet composed. NODE-29 requires both trusted markers and never accepts provider-native model strings.

Production DI that installs DeepAgentTaskExecutor into ControlServices.agentic and binds result/timeline persistence is not yet activated. The TaskPort-compatible executor and safe state delta are implemented.
Hosted GitHub Actions cannot allocate a runner while the account payment/spending-limit condition persists. No hosted pytest/Ruff/Pyright result may be claimed until a runner executes steps.
